title: Wave propagation stable camera
prerequisite: Learner can read peaks and troughs on a sine wave.
success_check: Learner predicts where the tracked crest moves next before replaying, then compares.

scenes.title: Traveling wave with fixed camera
scenes.concept_target: Follow wave propagation with a stable frame while a lambda callout tracks one crest.

narration_cues.text: A traveling sine wave appears on a fixed camera. Watch one crest as the wave moves in a steady direction, one wavelength lambda from the next crest.
narration_cues.change: The wave, one crest dot, and the lambda wavelength arrow appear in a stable frame.

narration_cues.text: The highlighted crest is tracked in the same direction with no camera motion. The lambda callout follows the crest so propagation stays clear.
narration_cues.change: The crest dot, wavelength arrow, and lambda callout glide right as the phase advances.
